onboarding_body: Meet people who are here for the same reason you are — honestly.
onboarding_panel_body: New here or returning? Choose a secure sign-in method to continue.
onboarding_legal_notice: Before registration is complete, you will review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
phone_verification_body: We’ll use it to confirm that there is a real person behind your account.
phone_verification_preview: Enter a local phone number with 7–15 digits to enable the mock request.
verification_code_body: Enter the six-digit code we sent to your phone number.
verification_code_preview: Flow preview: enter 012345 to verify your phone number.
verification_code_invalid: That code does not match. Check the code and try again.
age_eligibility_body: We use your date of birth to confirm you are eligible to join.
age_eligibility_preview: Phone verification is complete in this flow preview.
age_eligibility_invalid_date: Enter a valid date using the DD.MM.YYYY format.
age_eligibility_underage: You must be at least 18 years old to join Honest Dating.
consent_body: Please review and accept the documents that explain how Honest Dating works.
consent_preview: Legal-document content and version recording will be added here later.
terms_of_service_placeholder: The approved Terms of Service will be displayed here before this flow is released.
privacy_policy_placeholder: The approved Privacy Policy will be displayed here before this flow is released.
identity_verification_body: A brief selfie check helps keep Honest Dating safe and genuine.
identity_verification_preview: FaceTec Test API is enabled for this iOS debug build. Camera access is needed to continue.
identity_verification_cancelled: The selfie check was cancelled. You can start it again when you are ready.
identity_verification_camera_permission_: Camera access is required for the selfie check. Enable it in Settings, then try again.
identity_verification_unavailable: Selfie testing is available only in an iOS debug build with the local FaceTec SDK installed.
identity_verification_failed: We could not complete the selfie check. Check your connection and try again.
